graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary text, filled action buttons, and dominant borders — near-black provides maximum contrast against the warm cream canvas

cream.$description: Cream — Page canvas and soft surface washes — the warm off-white foundation of every section

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, button text, and inverted text on black — the cleanest layer above cream

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Shadow tint and near-white lavender surface — appears as the soft drop-shadow color (rgba 0.3) that makes cards feel like they hover

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline borders, link underlines, and light dividers

slate.$description: Slate — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

fog.$description: Fog — Body text secondary level and subdued border color

mist.$description: Mist — Nav inactive text and lightest nav border

wisteria.$description: Wisteria — Primary lavender card surfaces, badge backgrounds, and brand-accent fills — the soft purple room tone

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Mid-violet badge fills and icon highlights — deeper brand accent used sparingly inside lavender contexts

lime-voltage.$description: Lime Voltage — High-energy accent card surface and highlight badge — the vivid chartreuse that creates urgency and visual stop

sky-signal.$description: Sky Signal — Info badge background and location-tag accent — cool blue for map/location context

founders-grotesk.$description: Display headlines and hero — oversized 700-weight with tight 0.80 leading creates the confident, almost editorial voice. Sizes above 60px are signature-defining; 119px is reserved for the primary hero statement.
